SEATED RECOVERY 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Quads
SECONDARY
Core, Calves, Hamstrings

Instructions

Preparation: Dial in seat and bar height — seat level with the bars for most. Clip or strap in, grip the bars with a firm but relaxed hold.

1

Stay seated; pedal with controlled resistance.

2

Keep your knees tracking over your feet.

3

Keep a relaxed hold on the bars.

4

Rise from the saddle; keep pedalling controlled.

5

Support yourself through the pedals and bars.

6

Sit back onto the saddle smoothly.
